tools.name: audit_website
tools.description: Grades a public website out of 100 (A–F) across speed & mobile (including Google's live PageSpeed mobile test), Google visibility (SEO), trust & security, and lead capture. Returns every problem ranked by impact with a plain-English fix, what already works, and a link to a shareable full report. Use when the user asks to audit, grade, check, review or analyse a website, its SEO, speed or conversion. Takes 10–40 seconds.

url.description: The website address, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/page

tools.name: request_help
tools.description: Sends the user's request for help fixing their website to Soofi Digital's team, who will contact them by email or WhatsApp. Only use when the user explicitly asks for help or for Soofi Digital to contact them, and only with contact details the user has given you for this purpose. Confirm the details with the user before sending.

phone.description: Optional WhatsApp/phone number with country code, e.g. +1 555 123 4567

website.description: The website they want help with

message.description: Optional: what they want help with, in their words
